encounter.notes: ROUTE B: geometry is the EXTRACTED game mesh ArgonianBehemoth_A_Red_Basic, not a reconstruction. Bulky tailed saurian; bbox depth exceeds height because of the tail.

side_plates.why: The gallery publishes no full-body left or right profile. view-02 and view-10 are three-quarter rears and view-05 is a HEAD-only profile crop, none of which is a profile of the whole subject. measure-view-coverage says a real pair would take grazing fill 42.6% -> 19.3%, so the loss is real and is accepted rather than synthesised.

closeups.rejected_reason: head-region width error 4.96% at scale 0.500 looked healthy, but the 50% overlay shows THREE eyes, a doubled crown-spike row and a doubled jaw - the closeup is offset about a third of a head width horizontally. Judged by feature doubling, not by the metric.
16.72% at scale 0.770; the overlay doubles both arms and the whole torso, shifted up-left.
16.02% at scale 0.580; the overlay ghosts the far arm and the back ridge into empty space to the left.

reference.closeup_note: All three candidates rejected. The gallery's closeups are perspective crops of a DIFFERENT camera position from the base plates (the base plates are wide action shots, the closeups are pushed in with a different lens), so the single scale+translate the registrar fits cannot align them. Oaxiltso is built from the two base plates alone.

geometry.provenance: EXTRACTED game mesh ArgonianBehemoth_A_Red_Basic.glb (feat/trial-boss-models), 8,130 tris, 22 welded shells. Already +Y up / +Z front / feet at y=0; passed through prepare-static-boss.py --normalize-height 2.0 (uniform x0.5013) before projection. No Hunyuan step and no GPU: the geometry is correct by construction, so nothing is reconstructed.

regions.note: Single head box, VERIFIED on a membership render (_advice-crops/oaxiltso-boxcheck.jpg): red claims the skull, snout, jaw and crown spikes and stops at the neck; shoulders, back ridge, arms, legs and tail unclaimed. The first attempt ([0.24,0.66,0.68]-[0.76,1,1]) also swallowed the whole shoulder yoke and upper back - invisible in any metric, caught only by the render. No scalar head_v_min warp; head_v_min 0.68 is retained only as the default v-gate for head-region closeups.

uv_density.note: Legacy scalar warp disabled; regions.boxes drives the density warp.
